description.value: YuWala Marine Charters operates out of Bella Bella, the gateway to the Great Bear Rainforest, offering Indigenous heritage and eco-tours led by knowledgeable Heiltsuk guides across the channels, fiords, and outer islands of BC's Central Coast. Tours include wildlife viewing of bears, wolves, whales, and eagles, as well as cultural storytelling, traditional salmon BBQs, and exploration of ancient clam gardens and rock carvings. The company also runs practical marine transportation — water taxis, dive charters, and crew shuttles — making it a key logistics hub for the remote Central Coast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is reachable and describes an active marine charter and eco-tour operation based in Bella Bella, BC, on Heiltsuk Nation territory. No amenity information relevant to cyclists (bike parking, washrooms, water, etc.) appears anywhere on the site. The FAQ subpage contains lorem ipsum placeholder text in several answer fields, indicating the website is partially incomplete, but the core service descriptions on the front page are substantive and clearly describe a real operating business.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating marine charter and eco-tour business in Bella Bella with an active website describing substantive services. Relevant to touring cyclists as a notable attraction and transport hub in a very remote region.
enrichment_extras.notes: This is an Indigenous-owned business operated by members of the Heiltsuk Nation. The 'always_include' flag is set in the OSM record, consistent with its value as a rare attraction in a very remote coastal community.
